job_title: Entry-Level Software Engineer — Naval Radar & Simulation
job_description: Technology Service Corporation Defense Services in Silver Spring, MD, is looking for an entry-level Software Engineer to support Navy radar and combat systems development. Responsibilities include model and component integration, design contributions, and testing. Candidates should have a degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering and skills in C/C++ or Java. The expected salary range is $83,000 - $108,000 annually, with additional bonuses and benefits including stock options and flexible schedules.
